(NYSE: RVTY), today reported financial results for the third quarter ended October 4, 2026. The Company reported GAAP earnings per share from continuing operations of $0.56, as compared to $0.41 in the same period a year ago. Revenue for the quarter was $729 million, as compared to $699 million in the same period a year ago. GAAP operating income from continuing operations for the quarter was $95 million, as compared to $82 million for the same period a year ago.
